name: Trial Rumors
background: An anonymous observer present near the High Priest's residence. They provide a mixture of accurate observations and distorted street rumors regarding the trial.

genericReactions.physical: I saw them lead him away in chains. That much is true.
genericReactions.testimonial: Some say the witnesses contradicted each other. Others say he confessed.
genericReactions.digital: I don't know what the official charge was. Blasphemy, I think.
genericReactions.environmental: It all happened at the High Priest's house, in the middle of the night.
genericReactions.analytical: So many people involved... it's hard to know what to believe.
genericReactions.prophecy: They say he claimed to be the Son of God. Is that a crime?
